author: DoctorMK
quote:
GTA 6 is the biggest bait and switch in gaming history. The people making it clearly didn't want to make a GTA game, they wanted to make a RDR3 game, they wanted to make "Bonney and Clyde 2026" but this was supposed to be a GTA game, and it's a failure at that. 

GTA 6 is a game about committing crimes and mass murder that doesn't *want you* to commit crimes or murder people. Everything is on rails. The relationship is forced, poorly written, and a female power fantasy. Everything about the Lucia and Jason relationship is obviously from a female perspective. Jason is a soulless Gollum that exists only to serve Lucia. Lucia is a horrible person that no man would ever want to see again. She never has to face any accountability for anything. 

Grand Theft Auto is supposed to be Male Power Fantasy the Game. Period. Lets look at Vice City for example: its a clear Homage to Goodfellas and Scarface without any of the consequences. Your character escapes a jail transfer is working for the mob within a day. You're committing crimes, moving up the ladder and there are no consequences for killing anyone. The game doesn't try to force morality on you. There is no "bad ending" you win. Unlike Scarface or reality, we don't want a realistic ending, we want to become the big Kingpin and sit at the top of the tower as a Billionaire and Roll Credits. All our enemies are in the ground. The End. That was Vice City. 

GTA 6 is a Relationship Sim game, Female empowerment fantasy, and it doesn't want you to commit crimes or be awesome. It wants to tell you a story and you're supposed to sit down and listen. It wants you to make the soft choices and retire from a life of crime with your gf and baby and kill as few people along the way as possible. Again, that is not GTA at all. 


You can't steal whatever cars you want. You cannot kill whoever you want wherever you want. And not just for story reasons. For "Modern Audience" reasons. There are tons of gameplay flaws too. There are missions you either cannot fail or have large windows of "crash the plane while triggering the cut scene and you're fine" type stuff. There are car jumps on a highway section that you can't fail. This is all within the first 5 hours of the game too, so who knows how much Wolverine nonsense they put in there. 

GTA is dead. Modern Writers killed it
RIP GTA
1997-2026
